# GitHub Repository SEO Configuration

Configure these settings in the GitHub repository UI for maximum search engine discoverability.

---

## Repository Settings (Settings → General)

### Description
```
HunterX — AI-Assisted Vulnerability Hunter. Production-grade Red Team orchestration framework with 4-stage reasoning pipeline, 200+ detection signatures, REST API, AI/ML analysis, and plugin system. Apache 2.0.
```

### Website
```
https://nullc0d30.github.io/HunterX
```

---

## Topics (Settings → General → Topics)

Add ALL of these topics (comma-separated):

```
security, penetration-testing, vulnerability-scanner, red-team, bug-bounty,
cybersecurity, offensive-security, python, web-security, osint,
vulnerability-assessment, security-tools, web-application-security,
penetration-testing-tool, network-security, ethical-hacking
```

---

## Social Preview (Settings → General → Social Preview)

Upload `docs/assets/images/hunterx-social.png` (1200×630px).

---

## Pages (Settings → Pages)

Set **Source** to: `Deploy from a branch → main → /docs`

---

## Additional Metadata

The following files are already in the repository and automatically indexed:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `.github/FUNDING.yml` | GitHub Sponsors configuration |
| `CITATION.cff` | Academic citation metadata |
| `SECURITY.md` | Security policy (detected by GitHub) |
| `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` | Community standards (detected by GitHub) |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Contribution guidelines (detected by GitHub) |
| `SUPPORT.md` | Support resources (detected by GitHub) |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Development roadmap |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Release history |
| `docs/` | GitHub Pages documentation site |
